comparison_scope: Architecture-derived useful inference state. Physical serving-engine allocation may differ because of cache pages, alignment, padding, fragmentation, checkpointing and allocator overhead.
important_caveats: Qwen GDN value represents real recurrent-state bytes, not its padded 544-token vLLM page.
Falcon uses the FP16-conv + FP32-SSM analytical scenario for this comparison. Actual serving dtype must be confirmed experimentally.
Kimi KDA is bounded state while MLA is compressed token-growing cache.
These values compare useful state rather than total GPU memory consumption.
